attributes.context: Section 9.8.1 provides that upon written Union request negotiations will commence on rates of pay for new jobs and disposition of displaced employees resulting from the new methods, and 9.8.2 provides for final and binding arbitration if agreement is not reached.

extraction_text: 8 Notwithstanding the above, it is agreed that should the Employer intend to institute electronic check-out systems which would have direct, material impact on employment covered by this Agreement, the Employer shall give the affected Union or Unions at least sixty (60) days' written, advance notice by certified or registered mail setting forth the nature of such intended changes and/or methods of operations.

attributes.context: Section 8 requires the Employer to give affected unions at least 60 days' written advance notice if it intends to institute electronic check-out systems with direct material impact on employment.

extraction_text: 9.8.1 Upon written request by the Union, negotiations shall commence with respect to the following subjects: rates of pay for new jobs which might be created; transfer to comparable work, within or outside the bargaining unit or the disposition of displaced employees resulting from the institution of such new methods.

attributes.context: Section 8 requires 60 days' written notice for electronic check-out systems, 9.8.1 requires negotiation over new jobs and displaced employees, and the chunk also states that the arbitrator shall be selected under Section 18 and that 9.8.4 prevents installation from being impeded after the 60-day period.

extraction_text: 9.8.2 In the event the parties do not reach agreement within such period, then all unresolved issues as set forth above, shall be submitted to final and binding arbitration. It is not the intent of the parties that such negotiations or arbitrations will in any way jeopardize the efficiencies and increased productivity to be gained by the installation of such systems.

attributes.context: This sentence follows the 60-day notice, negotiation, and arbitration process for electronic check-out systems; the chunk later provides that decisions may be effective on or retroactive to the installation date and that self-checkout may be at employer discretion.

extraction_text: 9.8.4 It is agreed and expected that the parties will exert every effort to accomplish the foregoing within the sixty (60) day allotted period, but failing to do so, shall not prohibit or in any way impede the Employer from installing or effectuating any such new methods, systems, or equipment upon the expiration of the allotted sixty (60) day time period, unless such period is extended by mutual written agreement.

attributes.context: Sections 8 and 9.8.1 through 9.8.4 address electronic check-out systems, including advance notice, negotiations over displaced employees, arbitration, and the timing of installing new methods.

extraction_text: 9.8.5 SELF-CHECKOUT: The Employer may have, at its discretion, a multi-unit self-check stand, the parties agree to negotiate over the effects of the introduction of a second unit.

attributes.context: The clause is followed by Section 9.7.1, which requires the parties, after such consultation and negotiations, to determine the extent of the work transferred or removed and the number of jobs or hours lost by affected Union members, and to apply remedies based on those findings.

extraction_text: TRANSFER OR REMOVAL OF WORK: No work now being performed by employees in the unit covered by the collective bargaining agreement shall be transferred or removed from the unit without consultation and negotiation with the Union and unless the transfer or removal of such work is required for the purpose of promoting improved operating techniques, technological changes, automation or other factors connected with more efficient operations, as distinguished from reasons connected with securing the performance of such work at lower rates of pay or under less favorable employment conditions.
